MECA.TITLE: Air Mix Damper Servo Motor Control

ITEM.PTXT: For the value set with the temperature setting switch, the required outlet temperature is calculated by the neural network based on input conditions from each sensor, etc. A provisional target damper opening angle is calculated by applying corrections from the evaporator fin sensor and water temperature sensor to this required outlet temperature. The true target damper opening angle is calculated from this provisional target damper opening angle according to the illustration, and the air mix damper servo motor is rotated to the desired position by pulse signals.

Servo motors for switching the fresh/recirculation damper, the mode damper and the driver side air mix damper have been adopted on all models. In addition, a servo motor for switching the front passenger side air mix damper has been adopted on models w/ dual mode automatic air conditioner. Each servo motor is a pulse pattern type that detects position by pulse signals. With the adoption of pulse pattern type servo motors, a smart connector with a built-in IC having functions such as communication with the air conditioner computer is used.

The servo motors for the mode damper and the driver side air mix damper are installed on the right side of the heater & cooler unit, the servo motor for the front passenger side air mix damper on the left side of the heater & cooler unit, and the servo motor for the fresh/recirculation damper on the right side of the blower unit.

Whereas the conventional type detects position by potentiometer voltage, the pulse pattern type servo motor detects relative position by 2-bit ON/OFF signals. The air conditioner computer counts the number of pulses (patterns) to determine the stop position.

Smart connectors, intended to reduce weight and wiring, have been adopted to drive the pulse pattern type servo motors for air conditioner control. The smart connector contains an IC that combines communication with the air conditioner computer, servo motor drive and position detection functions.
Multi-step blower speed control, warm-up control, time-lag airflow control, etc. are used as blower control.
Sets the airflow according to the operating position of the blower switch.

When the AUTO switch on the air conditioning control section is turned ON, multi-step blower speed, warm-up, cool-down and time-lag airflow controls are performed using the target airflow calculated by the neural network based on input conditions from each sensor, etc.

When the AUTO switch on the air conditioning control section is turned ON, the air conditioning computer sends signals to the blower motor controller according to the target airflow calculated by the neural network, automatically controlling the airflow in multiple steps.

When the outlet mode is FOOT, BI-LEVEL or FOOT/DEF and the engine is cold, the blower motor is turned OFF and remains stopped until the engine coolant temperature (the temperature detected by the water temperature sensor) reaches a certain level or higher. When the coolant temperature reaches T2°C, the blower motor rotates at LO, and at T1°C or less the blower motor is turned OFF. When the coolant temperature is between T2°C and T3°C, the airflow calculated from the water temperature sensor is compared with the target airflow calculated by the neural network, and the airflow is automatically controlled at whichever is lower. When the coolant temperature reaches T3°C or higher, the blower motor rotates at HI, and is then controlled according to the target airflow calculated by the neural network.

2 types of time-lag airflow control are performed according to the temperature detected by the evaporator fin sensor, preventing hot air from blowing out of the center registers when the outlet mode is FACE or BI-LEVEL.

MECA.TITLE: When the evaporator fin sensor temperature is high (30°C or higher)

ITEM.PTXT: As shown in the illustration, the blower motor is turned OFF and the compressor is turned ON for approximately t1 seconds to cool the air conditioning unit. After approximately t1 seconds, the blower motor rotates in manual LO mode so that the cooled air blows out of the outlets, preventing discomfort caused by hot air blowing out. From approximately t2 to t3 seconds, the time-lag calculated airflow is compared with the target airflow calculated by the neural network, and the airflow is automatically controlled at whichever is lower. After approximately t3 seconds have elapsed, the airflow is controlled according to the target airflow calculated by the neural network.

MECA.TITLE: When the evaporator fin sensor temperature is low (below 30°C)

ITEM.PTXT: As shown in the illustration, the blower motor rotates in manual LO mode for approximately t4 seconds. After that, until approximately t5 seconds, the time-lag calculated airflow is compared with the target airflow calculated by the neural network, and the airflow is automatically controlled at whichever is lower. After approximately t5 seconds have elapsed, the airflow is controlled according to the target airflow calculated by the neural network.
Mode damper servo motor control, FOOT/DEF control at low temperatures, etc. are used as outlet control.
Switches to the outlets corresponding to the operating position of the mode select switch.

When the AUTO switch on the air conditioning control section is turned ON, the target damper opening angle is calculated from the outlet mode ratio calculated by the neural network, and the outlet mode is automatically switched among FOOT, BI-LEVEL and FACE according to this target damper opening angle.
When the conditions below (A or B) are met, the outlet mode is automatically switched to FOOT/DEF to prevent window fogging at low temperatures and during high-speed driving.
Manual control and fresh/recirculation damper servo motor control are used as inlet control.
Switches to the inlet corresponding to the operating position of the fresh/recirculation switch.

The target damper opening angle is calculated as shown in the illustration from the driver side target outlet temperature calculated by the neural network, and the fresh/recirculation mode is automatically switched according to this target damper opening angle. The timing of switching from recirculation to fresh air or from fresh air to recirculation is varied according to the vehicle speed.
Refrigerant pressure malfunction determination, external variable compressor capacity control, etc. are used as compressor control.

While maintaining the required outlet temperature, the air conditioning computer calculates the target evaporator fin temperature required to prevent discomfort due to the temperature difference between the inside and outside of the cabin and cabin humidity, and to prevent window fogging. In addition, it calculates target evaporator fin temperatures that take into account discomfort caused by excessively high temperatures from each outlet in FACE and BI-LEVEL outlet modes and quick defogging in DEF mode, and by comparing these, determines the target evaporator fin temperature that minimizes power consumption according to the vehicle condition. By using this for compressor control, both necessary and sufficient cooling capacity and low fuel consumption are achieved.
The air conditioning computer detects the refrigerant pressure, and when a refrigerant pressure malfunction is input, it turns the compressor OFF during that time.
When the temperature detected by the evaporator fin sensor is 1°C or less, the air conditioning computer turns the compressor OFF to prevent frosting of the evaporator.

The air conditioning computer detects the evaporator fin sensor temperature and refrigerant pressure, calculates the compressor capacity control output and performs frost control. When frost is determined, the air conditioning computer outputs a low compressor operation variable value to prevent frosting of the evaporator.

MECA.TITLE: Compressor 60-second ON Control (Window Fogging Prevention Control)

ITEM.PTXT: After the engine is started, when the conditions for turning the compressor ON are met (operation for the 1 time after the air conditioning computer is reset, blower OFF by warm-up control, evaporator fin sensor determination, outside air temperature determination, etc.), the air conditioning computer turns the compressor ON for 60 seconds according to the variable capacity control value. If even 1 of the above conditions is not met, the compressor 60-second ON control is canceled. In addition, when the condition for turning the compressor operating capacity OFF by refrigerant pressure malfunction determination is met, the compressor is turned OFF even during the 60 seconds.

The lowest of the compressor capacity control outputs calculated from frost control through low speed cut control is used as the compressor operating capacity to perform external variable compressor capacity control. This allows efficient compressor control according to the A/C operating condition, vehicle driving condition, etc., improving drive feeling and fuel economy.
The compressor operating capacity is output as shown in the illustration according to the A/C mode ON/OFF state.

The compressor operating capacity is output as shown in the illustration according to the engine speed. In addition, the minimum capacity output value is corrected according to the refrigerant pressure condition.

During acceleration, when cut signal 1 (during starting acceleration) or cut signal 2 (during passing acceleration) is input from the engine control computer to the air conditioning computer, the air conditioning computer reduces the compressor operating capacity output as shown in the illustration, reducing the fuel injection volume during acceleration and improving acceleration performance. The amount by which the compressor operating capacity output is reduced is varied according to the cooling load so that no difference in perceived temperature is felt.

At low engine speed, when cut signal 3 is input from the engine control computer to the air conditioning computer, the air conditioning computer outputs the compressor operating capacity as shown in the illustration.
The rear window defogger can be turned ON/OFF manually, but if 15 minutes elapse with the rear window defogger switch ON, it turns OFF automatically.

A control that quickly removes pollen around the faces of front seat occupants by simply pressing the pollen removal switch on the air conditioning control panel, without complicated air conditioning adjustments, is used.

When the pollen removal switch located in the air conditioning control panel is operated, the operation indicator light comes on, the air conditioning computer selects recirculation mode and Face outlet mode, and clean air that has passed through the clean air filter is blown toward the occupants' faces. In addition, pollen in the cabin is captured by the clean air filter.

Pollen removal control automatically returns to normal control after 3 minutes under normal conditions, or after 1 minutes when the outside air temperature is low. Pollen removal control is also canceled by pressing the pollen removal switch, the AUTO switch, or an outlet mode switch (including the DEF switch) during pollen removal control.
When the outside air temperature is low, the system does not switch to forced recirculation mode.
